thread:
Maya: Heads-up 0min: final pre-send QA for launch post + webinar routing. Need to confirm: redirect rules keep UTMs, canonical targets on legacy posts point at hub, FAQ schema + WebinarEvent present, and internal anchor plan for keyword flow. Link to draft email: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft

Diego: I ran a quick crawl of the affected blog set. Found 9 posts with missing rel=canonical or pointing to older landing. Will add canonical -> /webinar-hub/2026.

Lina: Quick ask about internal linking: should we add an in-post anchor to the registration form and also a top CTA to the landing? I recommend both for CTR.

Tom: Agree with both. For partner links we must not drop UTM_campaign or utm_source. nginx snippets updated to preserve query string. Example config snippet I pushed to infra PR:

```
# nginx redirect example
rewrite ^/promo/(.*)$ /webinar-hub/2026-04/$1 permanent; # preserves ?query by default
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
```

seo-bot: Redirect diff report: 7 new 301s, 2 modified rules, no loops. Note: add preserve_query param for legacy rewrite engine if using `return 301` style.

Maya: Good. Lina, can you paste the JSON-LD you plan to add? Need to confirm fields for Search Console preview.

Lina: putting example here 0sec:

```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Webinar","name":"Serving LLMs in Prod","startDate":"2026-04-08T17:00:00Z","description":"Benchmarking inference at scale","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-llms"}
```

Lina: Also adding FAQPage with 5 Qs about prerequisites, time, recording, slides, and support contact.

Diego: Keywords mapping done. Primary: "inference serving", "LLM inference cost", "low latency models". Secondary anchors added to blog intros linking to hub with anchor text matching primary keywords.

Tom: Ops note: deploy window 14:30-15:00 PT. ops-bot will run POST-deploy smoke tests for 200 ok and check for redirect chain >2.

ops-bot: Smoke job scheduled: JOB_ID=smoke-7893. Will post results here after deploy.

Maya: OK everyone 0min check: Diego add canonical tags, Lina push JSON-LD + FAQ, Tom land nginx patch, ops-bot run smoke test. If all green, I'll send partner email with the benchmark blurb and webinar registration link. :rocket: :email:
